name: Follett Software Inc
desc:
Customer Service Representative | $17 to $21/hr.  | Order Entry Heavy, Phone and Email
Company: Follett Software, LLC
Industry: Education Technology / Software for Schools and Districts
What Your Day Will Look Like: You'd be the go-to person for school and district customers who need help with their software and technology orders. That means answering phone calls and emails, entering new orders for products, services, and renewals, and building or changing support quotes when needed. When a customer has a warranty, billing, or order problem, you'd dig through several systems to fix it, ideally on the first call. You'd also follow up on open orders to get the information you need to finish them, and keep in touch with customers after the sale so the relationship stays healthy. Along the way you'd work with other teams like Order Entry, Sales, and Accounts Receivable to get purchase orders through.
assessment: Expect a basic assessment, a typing test, and a home internet speed test, since the posting doesn't state otherwise.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: High school degree or equivalent.
Required Experience: 1 to 3 years of customer success or account management experience supporting revenue clients is listed as necessary.
Preferred Experience: GoTo phone system or a similar platform. Salesforce. At least beginner level Microsoft Word and Excel.
Required Skills:
Strong troubleshooting and analytical ability
Detail oriented with accurate data entry
Ability to manage multiple customers' demands with good time management
Strong organizational skills
Effective written and verbal communication
Proficient PC and software skills
Self-starter who works independently in a fast-paced setting
4. Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone with a couple of years in customer success, account management, or order-based customer service
Someone who is accurate with data entry and likes tracking an order until it is done
Someone comfortable switching between several systems while on a call
Someone who wants a remote role supporting schools and educators
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone with no customer service or account management background, since the experience line is stated as necessary
Anyone who needs a fixed, guaranteed schedule, since hours may be adjusted as the business needs
Anyone without a private, quiet place to work from home
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Order entry and processing
Customer success and account management
Quote creation and modification
First call resolution
Multi-system navigation
Warranty and billing support
Cross-department coordination
Data entry accuracy
Schedule adherence
Post-sale customer follow up
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process: 1. Application 2. Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you. 3. If assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen. 4. If phone screen passes you can expect the final interview. Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3-15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your experience supporting customers after a sale and keeping the relationship going.
How do you stay accurate entering orders while also talking with a customer?
Walk us through how you'd handle a customer whose order is stuck because information is missing.
How do you juggle several customers' needs at once without dropping anything?
What does a good first call resolution look like to you?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: Not stated in posting. Confirm directly.
Shift: Not stated. The posting says work hours and schedules are set around the needs of the position and the organization and may be adjusted as needed. A 90% or higher schedule adherence is expected.
Benefits: Not stated in posting. Confirm directly.
Equipment Provided: Not stated in posting. Participant needs a private, quiet workspace at home.
Felony Friendly?: Not stated.
Drug Test: Not stated.
Notes: The 1 to 3 years of customer success or account management experience is written as necessary, so this is not a true entry level role. It fits a participant who has handled orders, accounts, or renewals before, even in retail or inventory settings. The remote role is open only to people located in the United States who can work without sponsorship, with no state restrictions listed. Travel is minimal, under 10%. The posting is marked New, and no closing date is shown.
Career Pathway: Not stated directly in posting. Reasonable inferred path: Customer Service Representative → Senior Customer Success Representative → Account Manager → Customer Success Manager, though this is an estimate, not confirmed by Follett directly.
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
